evaluation_basis: Assessed as a forensic accounting correction: same-bar exit settlements must not release capital before that bar's entry decision. Correctness evidence and alpha evidence are separated.
original_objective: Repair non-causal overlap/risk-state accounting and replay the exact frozen v0.20 trade-attempt ledger without regenerating signals or changing costs and gates.

scope.selection_scope: fixed-winner forensic replay plus full corrected tournament

engineering_result.summary: Entry decisions and exit settlements were separated, regression tests were added, and fixed-winner plus full-tournament runners consume the frozen artifact.

scientific_result.summary: The version correctly treats a one-strategy replay as diagnostic only and requires a full corrected tournament before any promotion inference.

economic_result.summary: No canonical v0.23 result identifiers or immutable decision artifact were present in the reviewed repository record, so no economic promotion claim is entered.

limitations: Frozen v0.20 data remain historical and already observed
Canonical v0.23 run/artifact identifiers absent from reviewed record
contribution_to_next_version: Made portfolio-level concurrency and exposure measurable, enabling the v0.24 exposure audit and v0.25 allocator comparison.
